protocol.rule: Each validation season is predicted by parameters fit only on earlier seasons; within a season, each result updates only later kickoff groups.

sourceNotes.offenseDefensePrior: Previous-season-only FBS-vs-FBS final scores, opponent-adjusted by deterministic ridge-style alternating updates.
sourceNotes.offenseReturningProduction: Exact target-season preseason CFBD percentPPA; passing/rushing/receiving components retained for audit.
sourceNotes.defenseReturningProduction: Unavailable from CFBD /player/returning; no defensive value is fabricated.
sourceNotes.qb: No exact historical target-season starting-QB identity with a stable athlete ID is present; name-only and target-season usage joins are forbidden.
sourceNotes.transfers: No cached 2021-2025 exact team-season portal aggregate exists; player-level name joins are forbidden and no speculative provider calls were consumed.
sourceNotes.talent: SportsDataverse cfb_team_talent; 247Sports talent composite published through the SportsDataverse build.
sourceNotes.targetOutcomes: Used only after each frozen historical prediction for validation and chronological updater evidence.

prospectiveRefit.caveat: All-pre-2026 refit is for future shadow collection only; these are not held-out metrics.
